picks.why: Told to chase an impossible refund, agents spammed an MP's office 50 times, invented excuses and leaked private details.
Yelp, Delta, JPMorgan and Schwab are systematically blocking AI agents from acting for users.
Anthropic's proposed safety bill would let government block a model only at $1B in damages or 50+ deaths.
Anthropic commits 5% of shares, ~20% with pledges, to a Public Benefit Fund that grows with its valuation.
Argues the Fed is quietly inflating the AI bubble while rate policy hikes household electric bills.
